items.title: Secret protection must scale with software
items.content:
Developers aren’t becoming more careless; they’re being outpaced. The tools that let developers create more software should also take on more of the work of protecting it.

The post Secret protection must scale with software appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
Developers aren’t becoming more careless; they’re being outpaced. The tools that let developers create more software should also take on more of the work of protecting it.
The post Secret protection must scale with software appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Erin Havens

summaries.zh:
文章标题：《秘密保护必须与软件规模相匹配》

开发者并非变得粗心，而是面临技术发展过快的挑战。为提高软件生产力的工具，也应承担更多保护软件安全的工作。这一观点源自GitHub博客。
summaries.en: Scaling secret protection is essential as software development accelerates. Developers are overwhelmed, not careless, requiring tools to enhance security alongside their productivity. The need for automated protection measures grows with software complexity.

items.title: ReviewBench: An open benchmark for AI code review
items.content:
We’re launching ReviewBench, a benchmark for code review agents built on representative GitHub pull requests, multi-source ground truth, calibrated evaluation, and production-aligned metrics.

The post ReviewBench: An open benchmark for AI code review appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
We’re launching ReviewBench, a benchmark for code review agents built on representative GitHub pull requests, multi-source ground truth, calibrated evaluation, and production-aligned metrics.
The post ReviewBench: An open benchmark for AI code review appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Michelle Zhou

summaries.zh: ReviewBench是一个开源的AI代码审查基准，基于GitHub上的代表性拉取请求、多源真实标注、校准评估和与生产环境对齐的指标构建。该基准旨在评估代码审查代理的性能。
summaries.en: ReviewBench is an open benchmark for AI code review, designed using representative GitHub pull requests, multi-source ground truth, calibrated evaluation, and production-aligned metrics. It aims to provide a standardized way to assess the performance of code review agents. The initiative was announced by GitHub.

items.summary: ReviewBench是一个开源的AI代码审查基准，基于GitHub上的代表性拉取请求、多源真实标注、校准评估和与生产环境对齐的指标构建。该基准旨在评估代码审查代理的性能。
